justification: The only shared depicted content is the human figure in the broadest sense: A shows tiny schematic stick-like figures among boat-shaped outlines, circles, cup-marks and linear signs scattered across a broad flat panel, while B shows a single large, rounded, naturalistically modelled nude body in high relief standing against an upright slab on a stepped base. There is no correspondence in posture, attributes, composition or drawing convention: A is a dispersed multi-motif linear repertoire, B is a single volumetric standing body treated in the round.
